name: ginga-node
description: Node.js middleware and static asset distribution package for GingaF Flutter Web

scripts.flutter:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if (!fs.existsSync('../build/web/index.html')) cp.execSync('cd .. && flutter build web --release', { stdio: 'inherit' }); else console.log('Flutter web build exists, skipping build.');"
scripts.dev: node scripts/bundle-examples.js && node scripts/build.js && node scripts/serve.js index.html
scripts.build: npm run flutter:build && npm run copy:assets && npm run bundle:examples && node scripts/build.js && tsc
